text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm shopping at the mall when I see
Admire Vega
consoling a crying boy.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hey, what happ—

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Waaah!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's what I'd like to know.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaah! I'm scared!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
He's been like this for a while now. I've
tried
talking to him, but he won't stop
crying.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh? I said I've already tried everyth—
choice_data_list: まずは落ち着かせよう

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Okay.
choice_data_list: 俺が見てるから、係の人を呼んできて
私が見てるから、係の人を呼んできて
choice_data_list_en: I'll keep an eye on things, so go call an attendant.
I'll keep an eye on things, so go get a staff member.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In just a few minutes, we successfully get
the mall
staff to make an announcement
over the PA
system.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Big siiis! I was so scared!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
And I told you not to go off on your
own! You'd
better not let go of my hand
this time!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Me too.
choice_data_list: 見つかってよかったね

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the boy evidently in a state of
panic from
being lost, we pat him on the
back and try our
best to reassure him.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: ...Sniffle. My sister... I don't know where she is.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I'm sure your sister is also
looking for
you. Where did you two get
separated?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, after we get enough information
from the
boy...

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Bye bye!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
